Assignment: Propose an idea for the course to improve next semester.

Summary: Upon inspections of the variables, I realized what led me to be sucessful prior to no coding. I watched old class lectures. I would put them on 2x speed a day before class and walk into class having confidence of what I was doing. I believe that if there were specific videos to target the lecture beforehand. Everyone who is a noob like me can be a noob still but.... they can understand everything better! Below are some charts which try to prove my point.

## Box Plot: People who do not understand want this!
![My Photo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/briy1th/briy1th.github.io-bun/main/52d071ef-21e2-4bbb-a31e-61e899b44b1c.png)
Look at this box plot! It may seem at first glance that the more you understand seems to correlate with wanting pre lecture videos less. However, it also means that people who do not understand, want these videos! This means that people believe this would have helped them. I know from experience that it did! I struggled most on the topics I could not find videos for on the website.
